raw.title: Update FabriKt entry (Kotlin code generator)
raw.body:
## Description
This PR updates the entry for **FabriKt** to reflect its current feature set and architectural philosophy. 

### Key changes:
- **Expanded Frameworks:** Added support for Micronaut and Ktor (both client and server).
- **Serialization:** Included `kotlinx.serialization` alongside Jackson.
- **Positioning:** Refined the description to highlight that the tool is designed for "permanent integration" (Contract-as-Code) rather than just initial bootstrapping.
- **Links:** Updated the main link to the project's vanity domain https://fabrikt.io.
- **Version Support:** Enabled the `v3_1` flag as the tool now fully supports OpenAPI 3.1 features.

The `id` has been kept identical to ensure the existing entry is updated rather than duplicated.
